prompt: Edit only the wing pose in Image 2 so it matches Image 1's frozen asymmetric wing angles. Preserve Image 2's front-facing head, horns, body, exactly four separately visible legs and feet, centered single tail, colors, feather groups, scale pattern, lighting, background and framing pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. No other changes, no text.
